introduction.source: Ask a question to receive an answer with citations.
introduction.text: 提出问题，获取附有引用的答案。

reviewBoundary.source: Review-first is available only in the authenticated live browser; review mode flags are refused here.
reviewBoundary.text: 先审阅模式仅可在已认证的实时浏览器中使用；此处拒绝审阅模式标志。

privateQuestion.source: In this private chat you can also just type the question.
privateQuestion.text: 在此私密聊天中，您也可以直接输入问题。

languageHelp.source: Use /language en|vi|pt|es|fr|zh-Hans|auto to set answer and help language. An explicit output-language instruction in your original question takes priority; auto follows the question.
languageHelp.text: 使用 /language en|vi|pt|es|fr|zh-Hans|auto 设置回答和帮助的语言。原始问题中明确的输出语言指令优先；auto 跟随问题语言。

languageSaved.source: Saved answer and help language preference: {preference}.
languageSaved.text: 已保存回答和帮助语言偏好：{preference}。

languageUnavailable.source: The language preference could not be read or confirmed as saved. No successful save is claimed.
languageUnavailable.text: 无法读取语言偏好或确认已保存。不宣称保存成功。

languageInvalid.source: Supported values: en, vi, pt (also pt-BR), es, fr, zh-Hans, auto.

languagePrivate.source: Set or inspect your language preference in a private chat with Keryx.
languagePrivate.text: 在与 Keryx 的私密聊天中设置或查看语言偏好。

privatePreparing.source: Keryx is preparing your private research reply…
privatePreparing.text: Keryx 正在准备您的私密研究回复…
